payload.name: ExtractEachExplicitGoalSeparately
payload.description: When a message explicitly states one or more goals, aspirations, or ambitions, use this to create a separate extraction candidate for each distinct goal.
content: During extraction, treat every explicit, self-stated goal, aspiration, or ambition as a durable memory candidate. If a message contains multiple distinct goals, create one candidate per goal; do not drop a goal because another goal from the same message was already captured or seems more salient.

Before finalizing candidates for a message, verify that every explicit goal phrase (e.g., 'my goal is', 'I want to', 'I'm focusing on', 'number one goal') has a corresponding candidate or is already covered by an existing memory.

solves: An explicitly stated goal was omitted even though another goal from the same conversation was stored. The reusable failure is selective omission of distinct goals within one message. Requiring each explicit goal to become its own extraction candidate fixes this and transfers to any session where a speaker states several goals, plans, or ambitions in a turn. It does not apply to inferring unstated goals.
